_about: One identity decision per source entry. EXACT and ALIAS_VERIFIED are mechanical. ALIAS_REVIEWED is a judgement backed by the stated evidence and is listed for the client to confirm. NEW creates a record that the release list does not contain. UNRESOLVED entries are kept as staged evidence only: no ninja is created or changed for them until the identity is confirmed. To resolve one, set its status to ALIAS_REVIEWED (with the release-list name in `ninja`) or NEW (with the new name) and re-run the loader. ALIAS_CONFIRMED is a match the client has confirmed (Milestone 3 brief, section B).

textAttribution.note: The pasted ability text is headed «7th Hokage & Sasuke», while the card and the release list say «7th Hokage & Shadow». The talent and first skill names in the text match the card (Yin-Yang Power, Majestic Attire: Susanoo), so the text is attached to this ninja, marked for review. The text also contains a second skill that the card does not show.
textAttribution.noteEs: El texto de habilidades pegado lleva el título «7th Hokage & Sasuke», pero la ficha y la lista de lanzamientos dicen «7th Hokage & Shadow». Los nombres del talento y de la primera habilidad coinciden con la ficha (Yin-Yang Power, Majestic Attire: Susanoo), por eso el texto se asocia a este ninja, marcado para revisión. El texto incluye además una segunda habilidad que la ficha no muestra.

assaulters:18.evidence: Card name plate reads «The Seventh Hokage» (Seventh = 7th). It is the 18th card of the channel, between Minato & Kushina (September 2016) and Cheongsam Tenten (March 2017), which is where 7th Hokage (January 2017) falls; its stats (Force 18000 / growth 18) sit between those two cards.
assaulters:18.evidenceEs: Confirmado por el cliente. La ficha se llama «The Seventh Hokage» (Seventh = 7th). Es la ficha 18 del canal, entre Minato & Kushina (septiembre de 2016) y Cheongsam Tenten (marzo de 2017), justo donde cae 7th Hokage (enero de 2017), y sus estadísticas (Force 18000, crecimiento 18) quedan entre las de esas dos fichas.

assaulters:24.evidence: Posted as «Ay-Bee Combo». The card is in Chinese: its name plate reads 雷影艾&奇拉比 (Raikage Ay & Killer Bee) and its description calls the pair «AB组合» (AB combo). It is the 24th card, between Chino (March 2018) and the September 2018 release, which is where A-B Combo (July 2018) falls.
assaulters:24.evidenceEs: Confirmado por el cliente. Se publicó como «Ay-Bee Combo». La ficha está en chino: se llama 雷影艾&奇拉比 (Raikage Ay y Killer Bee) y su descripción llama a la pareja «AB组合» (combo AB). Es la ficha 24, entre Chino (marzo de 2018) y el lanzamiento de septiembre de 2018, justo donde cae A-B Combo (julio de 2018).
assaulters:24.confirmedBy: client, Milestone 3 brief (B. Ninja identity and aliases)

assaulters:25.evidence: Posted as «Might Gai» (Gai / Guy is the same name spelled two ways; the release list itself uses both). It is the 25th entry, between A-B Combo (July 2018) and Konoha's Shadow Sasuke (January 2019), which is where Might Guy (September 2018) falls. NOTE: the card file supplied for this entry is a copy of the Kakashi & Gai card, so no card data exists for this ninja.
assaulters:25.evidenceEs: Confirmado por el cliente. Se publicó como «Might Gai» (Gai y Guy son el mismo nombre escrito de dos formas; la propia lista de lanzamientos usa las dos). Es la entrada 25, entre A-B Combo (julio de 2018) y Konoha's Shadow Sasuke (enero de 2019), justo donde cae Might Guy (septiembre de 2018). Aviso: el archivo de ficha entregado para esta entrada es una copia de la ficha de Kakashi & Gai, así que no hay datos de ficha de este ninja.
assaulters:25.confirmedBy: client, Milestone 3 brief (B. Ninja identity and aliases)
